CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_PAYMENTCARD_CCD_v3] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard
AS(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PaymentCardId ORDER BY CARD_DELTA_DATE DESC, Monthly_Daily ) RN, * FROM (
     SELECT
     BCC.CARD_DELTA_DATE
    ,BCC.CARD_NBR AS PaymentCardId
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_NAME1 AS EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN)) 
    END AS PaymentCardIssuedDate
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(datetime,CONVERT (varchar, BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE)) 
    END AS PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
    ,BCC.CARD_PDT_NBR AS PaymentCardTypeId
    ,BCC.CARD_BANK_NBR AS BankNumber
    ,BCC.CARD_SHORT_NAME AS PaymentCardShortName
    ,BCC.CARD_SUP_REL AS PaymentCardHolderTypeId
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT (varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE )) 
    END AS PaymentCardClosedDate
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_REQ1 AS EmbossingDate
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_NAME2 AS PaymentCardGroup
    ,BCC.CARD_SEQ_NBR AS PaymentCardSequenceNumber
    ,BCC.CARD_FORMAT_ID AS PaymentCardFormatId
    ,BCC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
    ,BCC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_LST_DATE_ACTIVE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_LST_DATE_ACTIVE)) 
    END AS PaymentCardLastActivationDate
    ,CASE
        WHEN BCC.CARD_MEMBER_SINCE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_MEMBER_SINCE)) 
    END AS MemberSinceDate
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE)) 
    END AS PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
    ,getdate() as InsertDttm
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
    ,1 AS Monthly_Daily
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARFP BCC WHERE BCC.ISLATEST = '1'

UNION
    
    SELECT
     BCC.CARD_DELTA_DATE
    ,BCC.CARD_NBR AS PaymentCardId
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_NAME1 AS EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN)) 
    END AS PaymentCardIssuedDate
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(datetime,CONVERT (varchar, BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE)) 
    END AS PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
    ,BCC.CARD_PDT_NBR AS PaymentCardTypeId
    ,BCC.CARD_BANK_NBR AS BankNumber
    ,BCC.CARD_SHORT_NAME AS PaymentCardShortName
    ,BCC.CARD_SUP_REL AS PaymentCardHolderTypeId
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT (varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE )) 
    END AS PaymentCardClosedDate
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_REQ1 AS EmbossingDate
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_NAME2 AS PaymentCardGroup
    ,BCC.CARD_SEQ_NBR AS PaymentCardSequenceNumber
    ,BCC.CARD_FORMAT_ID AS PaymentCardFormatId
    ,BCC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
    ,BCC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_LST_DATE_ACTIVE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_LST_DATE_ACTIVE)) 
    END AS PaymentCardLastActivationDate
    ,CASE
        WHEN BCC.CARD_MEMBER_SINCE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_MEMBER_SINCE)) 
    END AS MemberSinceDate
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE)) 
    END AS PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
    ,getdate() AS InsertDttm
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
    ,2 AS Monthly_Daily
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARDP BCC WHERE BCC.ISLATEST = '1'

    )A
)



SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard WHERE RN =1;
--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar, EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName)
,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardIssuedDate)
,CONVERT(datetime, PaymentCardActivationTimestamp)
,CONVERT(numeric, PaymentCardTypeId)
,CONVERT(int, BankNumber)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardShortName)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardHolderTypeId)
,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardClosedDate)
,CONVERT(varchar, EmbossingDate)
,CONVERT(varchar, PaymentCardGroup)
,CONVERT(varchar, PaymentCardSequenceNumber)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardFormatId)
,CONVERT(numeric, SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit)
,CONVERT(numeric, SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit)
,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardLastActivationDate)
,CONVERT(date, MemberSinceDate)
,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp)
,CONVERT(varchar, SourceSystemCode)
,CONVERT(datetime2, InsertDttm)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, PaymentCardId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard 
)
,

TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar, EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName)
,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardIssuedDate)
,CONVERT(datetime, PaymentCardActivationTimestamp)
,CONVERT(numeric, PaymentCardTypeId)
,CONVERT(int, BankNumber)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardShortName)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardHolderTypeId)
,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardClosedDate)
,CONVERT(varchar, EmbossingDate)
,CONVERT(varchar, PaymentCardGroup)
,CONVERT(varchar, PaymentCardSequenceNumber)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardFormatId)
,CONVERT(numeric, SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit)
,CONVERT(numeric, SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit)
,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardLastActivationDate)
,CONVERT(date, MemberSinceDate)
,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp)
,CONVERT(varchar, SourceSystemCode)
,CONVERT(datetime2, InsertDttm)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, PaymentCardId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.PaymentCard
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT 
        SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
        ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
        ,ISNULL(SRC.PaymentCardId, TGT.PaymentCardId) AS PaymentCardId
        ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode, TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
        ,CASE
		    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
		    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	        ELSE NULL 
        END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_SRC SRC
    LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.PaymentCardId = TGT.PaymentCardId
    AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)



SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET
PaymentCardId = SRC.PaymentCardId
,PaymentCardToken = NULL
,MaskedPaymentAccountNumber = NULL
,EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName = SRC.EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
,PaymentCardIssuedDate = SRC.PaymentCardIssuedDate
,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp = SRC.PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
,PaymentCardTypeId = SRC.PaymentCardTypeId
,DebitCardIndicator = NULL
,PaymentCardNote = NULL
,BankNumber = SRC.BankNumber
,PaymentCardShortName = SRC.PaymentCardShortName
,PaymentCardHolderTypeId = SRC.PaymentCardHolderTypeId
,PaymentCardClosedDate = SRC.PaymentCardClosedDate
,EmbossingDate = SRC.EmbossingDate
,PaymentCardGroup = SRC.PaymentCardGroup
,PaymentCardSequenceNumber = SRC.PaymentCardSequenceNumber
,PaymentCardFormatId = SRC.PaymentCardFormatId
,SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit = SRC.SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
,SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit = SRC.SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
,PaymentCardLastActivationDate = SRC.PaymentCardLastActivationDate
,MemberSinceDate = SRC.MemberSinceDate
,PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp = SRC.PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId = 0
,TaskRunId = 0
,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.PaymentCard TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.PaymentCardId = TGT.PaymentCardId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard SRC 
ON SRC.PaymentCardId = TGT.PaymentCardId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'	
;


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.PaymentCard
(
PaymentCardId
,PaymentCardToken
,MaskedPaymentAccountNumber
,EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
,PaymentCardIssuedDate
,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
,PaymentCardTypeId
,DebitCardIndicator
,PaymentCardNote
,BankNumber
,PaymentCardShortName
,PaymentCardHolderTypeId
,PaymentCardClosedDate
,EmbossingDate
,PaymentCardGroup
,PaymentCardSequenceNumber
,PaymentCardFormatId
,SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
,SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
,PaymentCardLastActivationDate
,MemberSinceDate
,PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.PaymentCardId
,NULL AS PaymentCardToken
,NULL AS MaskedPaymentAccountNumber
,EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
,SRC.PaymentCardIssuedDate
,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
,SRC.PaymentCardTypeId
,NULL AS DebitCardIndicator
,NULL AS PaymentCardNote
,BankNumber
,PaymentCardShortName
,PaymentCardHolderTypeId
,PaymentCardClosedDate
,EmbossingDate
,PaymentCardGroup
,PaymentCardSequenceNumber
,PaymentCardFormatId
,SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
,SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
,PaymentCardLastActivationDate
,MemberSinceDate
,PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkflowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.PaymentCardId = SRC.PaymentCardId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
Where Record_status = 'INSERT';

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA;


END
GO
